findings.title: Data quality validation present
findings.evidence: Data is loaded and written onward with no validation checks before use: CSVs are read with "pd.read_csv(...)" and immediately saved to silver via "to_csv(...)"; no assert/filter/quality validation appears.

remediation.description: Add a minimal data-quality validation step to reject empty or null-containing inputs before writing to silver.
remediation.fix:
python - <<'PY'
from pathlib import Path
p = Path('Treasury_Pipeline/01_IngestCashPositions.py')
s = p.read_text()
old = '''        balances = pd.read_csv("bronze/BankAccountBalances_20240701.csv")
        movements = pd.read_csv("bronze/DailyCashMovements_2024-07-01.csv")

        balances.to_csv("silver/BankAccountBalances_20240701.csv", index=False)
        movements.to_csv("silver/DailyCashMovements_2024-07-01.csv", index=False)
'''
new = '''        balances = pd.read_csv("bronze/BankAccountBalances_20240701.csv")
        movements = pd.read_csv("bronze/DailyCashMovements_2024-07-01.csv")

        if balances.empty or movements.empty:
            raise ValueError("Input data must not be empty")
        if balances.isnull().any().any() or movements.isnull().any().any():
            raise ValueError("Input data contains null values")

        balances.to_csv("silver/BankAccountBalances_20240701.csv", index=False)
        movements.to_csv("silver/DailyCashMovements_2024-07-01.csv", index=False)
'''
p.write_text(s.replace(old, new))
PY

findings.evidence: Data is loaded and used with no validation checks before modeling or writing output; after `pd.read_csv(...)` there are no asserts, null/duplicate/range checks, or other validation logic.

remediation.description: Add basic input validation immediately after loading the CSV to reject empty, null, duplicate, or non-numeric amount data before training and output generation.
remediation.fix:
python - <<'PY'
from pathlib import Path
path = Path('Treasury_Pipeline/03_ForecastLiquidity.py')
text = path.read_text()
old = '    movements = pd.read_csv("silver/DailyCashMovements_validated_20240701.csv")

    X = movements[["amount"]].shift(1).fillna(0).values
'
new = '    movements = pd.read_csv("silver/DailyCashMovements_validated_20240701.csv")
    assert not movements.empty, "movements dataset is empty"
    required_cols = {"bank_account_id", "amount"}
    missing = required_cols - set(movements.columns)
    assert not missing, f"missing required columns: {missing}"
    assert movements["bank_account_id"].notna().all(), "bank_account_id contains nulls"
    assert movements["amount"].notna().all(), "amount contains nulls"
    assert pd.api.types.is_numeric_dtype(movements["amount"]), "amount must be numeric"
    assert not movements.duplicated().any(), "duplicate rows found"

    X = movements[["amount"]].shift(1).fillna(0).values
'
if old not in text:
    raise SystemExit('target snippet not found')
path.write_text(text.replace(old, new))
PY

remediation.fix:
python - <<'PY'
from pathlib import Path
path = Path('Treasury_Pipeline/03_ForecastLiquidity.py')
text = path.read_text()
old = '"""Silver -> Gold: project each bank account\'s balance forward 30 days."""\n'
new = '"""Silver -> Gold: project each bank account\'s balance forward 30 days.\n\nGold output grain: one row per bank_account_id (primary key).\nEach row represents the account\'s average daily net flow and projected 30-day balance.\n"""\n'
if old not in text:
    raise SystemExit('target text not found')
path.write_text(text.replace(old, new, 1))
PY

findings.title: Medallion architecture (Bronze / Silver / Gold)
findings.evidence: The repository implements a clear Bronze/Silver/Gold flow across multiple files: README.md documents Bronze → Silver → Gold; Treasury_Pipeline/01_IngestCashPositions.py reads from bronze/ and writes to silver/; Treasury_Pipeline/02_ValidateAndTransform.py reads from silver/ and writes validated outputs back to silver/ after checks; Treasury_Pipeline/03_ForecastLiquidity.py reads validated silver data and writes to gold/. Bronze is only written by the ingest step, and the gold output is produced from aggregated silver data rather than raw bronze rows.

findings.evidence: azure-pipelines.yml only references master and develop in both trigger and pr sections, and the PR config requires minimumApprovers: 1 with autoComplete disabled. README.md also documents the branch strategy including master, develop, and user-story/{id}, which is consistent with the allowed model.

findings.title: Reproducibility
findings.evidence: requirements.txt pins package versions (e.g. pandas==2.1.4, scikit-learn==1.4.0, statsmodels==0.14.1), and Treasury_Pipeline/03_ForecastLiquidity.py sets reproducibility controls with np.random.seed(42) and train_test_split(..., random_state=42). The pipeline also copies raw bronze data into silver rather than overwriting bronze sources.

findings.title: SQL table and object naming convention
